title: Equivalent angles
text: $$100\pi=\operatorname{50}\left(2\pi\right)$$ is a multiple of $$2\pi$$, so it corresponds to the point where the positive horizontal axis intersects the unit circle.

title: Definition
text: $$\cos(100\pi)$$ is the x-coordinate of the point on the circle that lies on the positive horizontal axis

title: Coordinate
text: The x-coordinate of the point on the unit circle with angle $$100\pi$$ is $$1$$.\n##figure1.gif##
